description: AGSC-04-02: verification is a double build followed by a byte comparison, and any difference is AGSC-E602. Derivation over the Bundle stated inline in input.files (a copy of the reference engine's with-assets fixture, carried here so that a port needs no file of any repository): its one concept references content/assets/logo.svg and content/assets/img/nested.svg; two builds at the same fixed instant emit the same route set with the same bytes at every route — the /assets/<path> routes of AGSC-06-01 included, since the served bytes are the file's own — so the comparison reports no AGSC-E602 and the build carries no error finding. Before rc.6 an asset route was emitted from a read that depended on the working directory, which is the kind of ambient input AGSC-04-03 forbids and this case would expose.
